comparison.objective: Remove a spring peg and clip a hanging photo corner to a wire.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained squeeze during transport and thin-object/wire alignment before controlled release.
comparison.success_condition: Second peg closes on both wire and photo near the corner; photo remains hanging and still.
comparison.reason: Tests spring-clip transport and thin-layer capture, not tool seating, collar rotation, bounded tightening or commissioning cycles.
